question: What is the difference between frontend and backend development?
intendedUser: Professional in Track-A with entry experience
description: Conceptual interview question for Track-A professionals.
exampleAnswer: Frontend is what users see (UI, UX); backend is server-side logic, databases, APIs. In my project, I built the React frontend with TypeScript and the Node.js backend with Express. Frontend focuses on user experience; backend focuses on data, security, and business logic. Full-stack developers work across both.
